activity_summary: You were not cast. From the parlour door you heard the gowns laugh before a line was done. Margery had thirty-three shillings in her box. You did not put the comedy on her stair. The thirty-three shillings were hers, not a share.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Stood in the door and kept the comedy off her stair.

entities.name: Goodwife Margery Pell
entities.context: Counted thirty-three shillings and sent him out of her feet.

entities.name: The Two Gentlemen of Verona
entities.context: Mentioned in Thirty-three, and the door

facets.activity: Heard Margery's thirty-three shillings from the parlour door

quotes.speaker: margery_pell
quotes.text: Lawyers, lawyers' men, two aldermen's wives and a horse-courser. Thirty-three shillings in mine.
